column2: Angel... This is the final battle, isn't it... I... I've only just realized that I've been protected all this time.{wait}{clear}By the Reyforia Forest, by this world, and by you, Angel...{wait}{clear}This time, I truly have to protect everyone. That is my mission.{wait}{clear}I'm not afraid of anything, because you are with me...{wait}{clear}I will defeat the Heavenly Dragon, no matter what.
Monsters in Kenner? I understand, I'll go!
A mysterious whirlwind? I understand, I'll go.{wait}{clear}Whatever happens in the forest, I think it's up to me to do something about it.
I understand, I'll head there at once. It's about the forest, so I have to go...
That's happening in the forest? Angel, I'll go right away!
Angel, I'll go. Something that cruel has to be stopped at once...!
I understand, Angel. I'll head to Loralai at once.{wait}{clear}Everyone there must be in trouble...
I understand, I'll go. Angel, I'll do my best and never give up, right to the end.
Monsters getting into the forest... It's because my power is too weak...{wait}{clear}It's my responsibility, Angel. I'll go at once. I'll go and defeat the monsters.

A band of thieves has appeared in the village of Galarus on Bremes Isle.{wait}{clear}Many villagers have suffered at their hands and are in great trouble. Would you go to Galarus and drive the thieves out?

Zombies have appeared in the village of Teruel in Deva.{wait}{clear}Villagers who go out at night are attacked, and it seems the zombies even raid homes in packs.{wait}{clear}For the village's sake, I'd like to ask you to get rid of them.
In Gauhati, in Karnal, a noble is using hired guards to torment the people.{wait}{clear}Would you go to Gauhati and save the townspeople?

A vampire has appeared in Albaria, and the village of Darus is under attack.{wait}{clear}The vampire preys only on young women. The villagers know and are resisting, but the victims keep growing in number.{wait}{clear}Won't you please destroy the vampire?
The Titans are on a rampage in Dilolo, on the southern edge of Reyforia.{wait}{clear}Will you go there before the harm to the forest clan spreads?

The Imperial army has begun its invasion of the village of Larissa in Celesta.{wait}{clear}Against the Imperial army, I doubt the villagers have any way to resist.{wait}{clear}Won't you please go to Larissa?
The Imperial army is advancing its troops toward Leus in Labirk.{wait}{clear}I'm worried for the nearby towns and villages, too. Will you go to Leus?
The Imperial army has begun an invasion of Lamia in Lefkas.{wait}{clear}Would you go there before the damage grows any worse?
The Imperial army has begun its invasion toward Jena in Lanas!{wait}{clear}Would you go to Jena and hold back the Imperial army?
The village of Kuhl in Lefkas is being attacked by a beast.{wait}{clear}It's a giant monster, and the villagers can't stand up to it.{wait}{clear}Won't you please go to Kuhl?

The Empire has begun to march.{wait}{clear}It's at Lucca in Labirk, and they say the army is led by a general named Kaiser.{wait}{clear}To hold back the Empire's invasion even a little, would you go there?
The Imperial army has begun invading the untamed lands as well.{wait}{clear}Troops are heading for Ragwort in Kenner. Would you go there?

People who enter the forest that covers the Zarha area, in the untamed lands, have been going missing. Several people from the village of Rais are missing too...{wait}{clear}I'd like you to go to that forest and find the cause. Will you do it?
The Grand Duke of Courrege's princess has been attacked by a vampire. But it seems she hasn't fallen under the vampire's control yet.{wait}{clear}Won't you please protect her?
